reply.text:
That sounds painful, and a bump on a collarbone after a fall is something to get looked at today. Please see a doctor or urgent care, not a coach, and tell them about the fall and the bump. I'm not going to guess at what it is.

Once a doctor or physio has cleared you, tell me what they said and we'll work out the training around it. Until then, the bike and any lifting that loads that shoulder are off the table.
